title: Alleged photograph of one live and one dead creature held by Pedro Aguiar
summary: James Fox tells of Alleged photograph of one live and one dead creature held by Pedro Aguiar, about 1996 at Varginha, Brazil, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: people that described he pulled the photograph out and showed it and it had uh one alive, one one deceased creature

plain: In 1996, in the Brazilian town of Varginha, people reported strange creatures, and one story from that time is about a photograph. A filmmaker named James Fox, speaking with podcast host Jesse Michels, says people told him that a man named Pedro Aguiar pulled out a photo showing two creatures, one alive and one dead. If true, it would be a picture of non-human beings taken in custody.
